title: Does the standing permission cover Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception?
lead: The standing permission names Apache-2.0 but not its LLVM exception. Wasmtime's 29 runtime and compiler crates carry only that expression, so adopting Wasm needs your decision in licences/RECORD (REQ-MOD-5).
bullets: The orchestrator read the exception as covered by the standing permission; you have not confirmed that.
No RECORD line carries it alone; wasip2 and wit-bindgen carry it as one choice of an OR.
PolkaVM's binding brings one such crate, regalloc2, only through its stand-in linker, off admission's path.
Declining it keeps Wasmtime off main at this pin, and leaves no format fit for production.
Until you rule, the licence check keeps Wasmtime off main and F-013 waits.
options: Confirm: the standing permission covers it
Reject as standing; rule each such crate one by one
Decline it; Wasmtime stays off main
